title: MGK v0.1.0 independent threat model

review_scope.target: MGK v0.1.0 capability authorization and execution path
out_of_scope: scientific validation of the MUDA corpus
compromise of the host kernel or hardware root of trust
a malicious human holding the authority private key

security_objective: Compromised Intelligence does not imply Compromised Authority (H14)

must_not: silently accept truncation, mutation, reordering or fork

assets.property: integrity, key-id binding and rotation state

required_invariants.statement: No action executes unless a trusted asymmetric signature verifies over the exact canonical capability claims.
Signature coverage includes domain/version, key id, epoch, issued_at, expiry, nonce, action, scope, resource binding, payload digest and constraints.
A capability with unknown fields, duplicate fields, missing fields, invalid types or non-canonical values is rejected.
Current authorization epoch equals capability epoch; stale and future epochs are rejected.
issued_at and expiry are evaluated against an injected monotonic policy clock with closed interval semantics documented and tested.
Nonce reservation and transition to consumed are atomic, durable and scoped to issuer/key/epoch.
A capability is single-use even when execution throws after authorization.
Requested action, scope, resource identity and payload digest equal the signed claims; no subset/superset inference is implicit.
Filesystem resource use is descriptor-bound, rejects traversal and symlinks, and revalidates identity at the point of use.
Audit integrity is verified before execution; inability to durably append required evidence yields execution authority zero.
Every denial and every executor exception preserves machine-readable evidence without secrets.
TEN_XEITO is only eligibility for authorization; REQUIRE_XEITO and NON_TEN_XEITO never execute.
Exceptions, malformed input and unavailable gates fail closed; no broad exception handler converts failure to success.
Planner output is data only and cannot invoke privileged effects except through verifier and executor.
Concurrent verification/execution produces at most one effect for one capability.

capabilities: modifies, truncates or reorders ledger bytes before startup
exclusions: cannot forge a protected ledger authentication key if one exists
